current.title: The Global Youth Statement 2025
current.intro: The Global Youth Statement brings together policy priorities developed by children and young people through YOUNGO consultations, working groups, and Conferences of Youth.
current.note: The 2025 statement was developed around COY20 in Belém and taken into YOUNGO’s COP30 policy work.

priorities.title: Fossil fuel phase-out
priorities.body: Science-aligned NDCs and a full, fair, and fast phase-out of fossil fuels.

priorities.title: Meaningful youth inclusion
priorities.body: Intergenerational equity and the meaningful inclusion of children and youth in climate policymaking.

priorities.title: Conflict & climate
priorities.body: Recognising the climate impacts of military conflict and calling for global ceasefires.

priorities.title: Climate finance
priorities.body: Reforming climate finance so it is rooted in justice and accessible to the most vulnerable communities.

priorities.title: Adaptation
priorities.body: Prioritising climate adaptation as a critical moral and political imperative.

process.body: Gathering submissions from working groups, LCOYs, NGOs, and individuals across the world.
50+ thematic policy hackathons refine and align children and youth positions.
Inputs consolidated for clarity, balance, and alignment with UNFCCC decisions.
The final document is disseminated and recognised across Parties, observers, and negotiation platforms.
